33053-camping-tramping-with-roosevelt.title: Camping Tramping With Roosevelt
33053-camping-tramping-with-roosevelt.creator: Unknown
33053-camping-tramping-with-roosevelt.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. At the time I made the trip to Yellowstone Park with President Roosevelt in the spring of 1903, I promised some friends to write up my impressions of the President and of the Park, but I have been slow in getting around to it. The President himself, having the absolute leisure and peace of the White House, wrote his account of the trip nearly two years ago!

64480-amour-amour-dear-planet.title: Amour Amour Dear Planet
64480-amour-amour-dear-planet.creator: Unknown
64480-amour-amour-dear-planet.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. "It takes more than an old cliff to do a spacecaptain in," Jan yelled. "Look baby, did you know we could do this?" Jan cut the power and let the aircar descend in a series of erratically fluttering loops. The mountain rushed up at them. The girl covered her eyes and sobbed, "Don't, please don't!"

67992-twentieth-century-french-writers-r.title: (Reviews And Reminiscences)
67992-twentieth-century-french-writers-r.creator: Unknown
67992-twentieth-century-french-writers-r.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. Why gather up Boylesve and André Gide, neglecting Estaunie, and Sageret, and Paul Adam? If I have Marie Lenéru, why not Sacha Guitry? Choosing Madame Colette, what reason have I for eliminating Madame de Régnier or Madame Delarue-Mardrus? I especially mourn the absence of the Brothers Tharaud, those perfect artists, who preserve the tradition of Flaubert.

arxiv-2105-08024.title: Sample-Efficient Reinforcement Learning Is Feasible for Linearly Realizable MDPs with Limited Revisiting
arxiv-2105-08024.creator: Gen Li, Yuxin Chen, Yuejie Chi, Yuantao Gu, Yuting Wei
arxiv-2105-08024.description: Abstract Low-complexity models such as linear function representation play a pivotal role in enabling sample-efficient reinforcement learning (RL). The current paper pertains to a scenario with value-based linear representation, which postulates linear realizability of the optimal Q-function (also called the “linear Q ⋆ Q^{\star} problem”).

arxiv-2206-06116.title: A Constructive GAN-based Approach to Exact Estimate Treatment Effect without Matching
arxiv-2206-06116.creator: Boyang You, Kerry Papps
arxiv-2206-06116.description: Abstract Matching has become the mainstream in counterfactual inference, with which selection bias between sample groups can be significantly eliminated. However in practice, when estimating average treatment effect on the treated (ATT) via matching, no matter which method, the trade-off between estimation accuracy and information loss constantly exist.

arxiv-2208-10683.title: Learning from Noisy Labels with Coarse-to-Fine Sample Credibility Modeling
arxiv-2208-10683.creator: Boshen Zhang*, Yuxi Li*, Yuanpeng Tu*, Jinlong Peng, Yabiao Wang †, Cunlin Wu, Yang Xiao, Cairong Zhao
arxiv-2208-10683.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Boshen Zhang*, Yuxi Li*, Yuanpeng Tu*, Jinlong Peng, Yabiao Wang †, Cunlin Wu, Yang Xiao, Cairong Zhao. Training deep neural network (DNN) with noisy labels is practically challenging since inaccurate labels severely degrade the generalization ability of DNN.

arxiv-2308-12521.title: The generalized Bernoulli numbers and its relation with the Riemann zeta function at odd-integer arguments
arxiv-2308-12521.creator: Yayun Wu
arxiv-2308-12521.description: Abstract Abstract: By using the generalized Bernoulli numbers, we deduce new integral representations for the Riemann zeta function at positive odd-integer arguments. The explicit expressions enable us to obtain criteria for the dimension of the vector space spanned over the rational by the \zeta(2n+1)/\pi^{2n} , n\geq 1 .

arxiv-2404-02729.title: Learning Sequence Attractors in Recurrent Networks with Hidden Neurons
arxiv-2404-02729.creator: Yao Lu, Si Wu
arxiv-2404-02729.description: Abstract The brain is targeted for processing temporal sequence information. It remains largely unclear how the brain learns to store and retrieve sequence memories. Here, we study how recurrent networks of binary neurons learn sequence attractors to store predefined pattern sequences and retrieve them robustly.

arxiv-2410-20740.title: A Comprehensive Study on Static Application Security Testing (SAST) Tools for Android
arxiv-2410-20740.creator: Jingyun Zhu, Kaixuan Li, Sen Chen, Lingling Fan, Junjie Wang, Xiaofei Xie
arxiv-2410-20740.description: Abstract To identify security vulnerabilities in Android applications, numerous static application security testing (SAST) tools have been proposed. However, it poses significant challenges to assess their overall performance on diverse vulnerability types. The task is non-trivial and poses considerable challenges.

arxiv-2512-14599.title: The role of mergers and rejuvenation in the buildup of the quiescent population at cosmic noon 2026 The role of mergers and rejuvenation in the buildup of the quiescent population at cosmic noon – 3
arxiv-2512-14599.creator: Jimi E. Harrold, Omar Almaini, Frazer R. Pearce, Robert M. Yates, Dave Maltby, Kate Rowlands, Vivienne Wild, Maya Skarbinski, Thomas de Lisle
arxiv-2512-14599.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Jimi E. Harrold, Omar Almaini, Frazer R. Pearce, Robert M. Yates, Dave Maltby, Kate Rowlands, Vivienne Wild, Maya Skarbinski, Thomas de Lisle. We investigate the quenching of galaxies using a mock observational lightcone generated from the Semi-Analytic Model (SAM) L-Galaxies, closely matched to observations from the UKIDSS Ultra Deep Survey (UDS). The sample is used to study merging, rejuvenation, and visibility times for star-forming, quiescent, and post-starburst (PSB) galaxies, to assess the impact on the build-up of the passive galaxy mass functions.

pmc-10672526.title: The First-Line Approach in Children with Obstructive Sleep Apnea Syndrome (OSA)
pmc-10672526.creator: Nicole Mussi, Roberta Forestiero, Giulia Zambelli, Letizia Rossi, Maria Rosaria Caramia, Valentina Fainardi, Susanna Esposito
pmc-10672526.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). Obstructive sleep apnea syndrome (OSA) is the main manifestation of sleep-disordered breathing in children. Untreated OSA can lead to a variety of complications and adverse consequences mainly due to intermittent hypoxemia. The pathogenesis of OSA is multifactorial.

pmc-11436936.title: Feature-based detection of breast cancer using convolutional neural network and feature engineering
pmc-11436936.creator: Hiba Allah Essa, Ebrahim Ismaiel, Mhd Firas Al Hinnawi
pmc-11436936.description: Breast cancer (BC) is a prominent cause of female mortality on a global scale. Recently, there has been growing interest in utilizing blood and tissue-based biomarkers to detect and diagnose BC, as this method offers a non-invasive approach. To improve the classification and prediction of BC using large biomarker datasets, several machine-learning techniques have been proposed.

pmc-12418539.title: Outcomes used to measure the clinical application of neonatal palliative and/or end-of-life care in neonatal settings: a systematic review
pmc-12418539.creator: Katie Gallagher, Kathy Chant, Veronica Parisi, Mehali Patel, Helena Dunbar, Fauzia Paize, Sophie Bertaud, Agnes Agyepong, Alexandra Mancini, Myra Bluebond-Langner, Neil Marlow
pmc-12418539.description: ObjectivesStandardised reporting of outcomes in neonatal palliative and/or end-of-life care would facilitate comparison of practice and lead to more informed decisions about practice. We systematically reviewed evidence evaluating outcomes currently used to characterise the clinical provision of palliative and/or end-of-life care in neonatal settings.

pmc-12693059.title: Dermoscopic Features of Non-Infectious Balanoposthitis
pmc-12693059.creator: Aleksejs Zavorins, Kristīne Nevidovska, Jūlija Voicehovska
pmc-12693059.description: Background/Objectives: Balanoposthitis encompasses a variety of non-infectious conditions that, in some cases, are risk factors for penile cancer. Clinical signs of non-infectious balanoposthitis are often unspecific, whereas dermoscopic features of dermatoses in the genital area can be altered. Current knowledge of the dermoscopy of balanoposthitis is incomplete.

pmc-12766614.title: Fetal magnetic resonance imaging diagnosis of pulmonary lymphangiectasia in hypoplastic left heart syndrome: Association with fetal echocardiography and postnatal outcome
pmc-12766614.creator: Greg Leonard, Alexia Egloff, Gema Priego, Tomas Woodgate, Wendy Norman, Milou PM van Poppel, Johannes Steinweg, Thomas Day, Vita Zidere, Owen Miler, Reza Razavi, John M Simpson, Trisha Vigneswaran, Kuberan Pushparajah, David FA Lloyd
pmc-12766614.description: BackgroundSecondary pulmonary lymphangiectasia (PL) is a recognised complication of hypoplastic left heart syndrome (HLHS) with an intact or restrictive atrial septum, associated with poor postnatal outcomes. Fetal MRI has been increasingly used to assess pulmonary abnormalities in HLHS, but the prognostic significance of subtle PL-like changes remains unclear.
